sources.title: We Tested Qwen3.8 27B: How Much GPU and VRAM Do You Really Need?
sources.snippet: The benchmark data below is labeled as Qwen3.8 27B because that is the model we tested. What Qwen3.8 27B Requires The Q4_K Small build used in our tests is 16.68 GiB and contains 27.32 billion parameters. That makes VRAM the first practical limit.
